speaker: Doctor
text: WELCOME TO THE CONSULTATION. I AM DR. AGENT. I SEE YOU ARE A NEWBORN PRESENTING WITH RESPIRATORY DISTRESS. TO HELP ME UNDERSTAND YOUR CONDITION, CAN YOU TELL ME WHEN THESE SYMPTOMS FIRST STARTED?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia. The history of prematurity (32 weeks), C-section delivery, and maternal gestational diabetes raises suspicion for this condition, but I need to confirm with imaging before finalizing. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray and Chest_X-Ray.
